sections.heading: Playing Stratigies
sections.wikitext:
Cherit is weak for a Major Hero so the best way to use him is when you don't have strong Major Hero in your hand. Cherit's '''Charge Up''' power can increase a Minor Hero's ATK so it can defeat many Minor Heroes and some Major Heroes. Of course, it can also be used to power up an already powerful Major Hero.
